episodes.title: Hide and Go Freak
episodes.summary: Bunsen, Mikey and Amanda play the beast version of hide-and-go-seek in Bunsen's house.

episodes.title: Bunsen Screams for Ice Cream
episodes.summary: Bunsen's love of ice cream almost gets him expelled when Amanda uses it to lure him out of school.

episodes.title: Bunsen is a Beast!
episodes.summary: Bunsen attends his first day of human middle school in hopes of proving that beasts and humans can happily co-exist.

episodes.title: Body and the Beast
episodes.summary: Bunsen literally loses his head on picture day and Mikey has to help him find it before picture time.

episodes.title: Bearly Acceptable Behavior
episodes.summary: Amanda tries to get Bunsen kicked out of school when he brings a dangerous bear to class.

episodes.title: Beast Busters
episodes.summary: Bunsen and Mikey must save Amanda from mischievous sneeze beasts that escape from Bunsen's nose.

episodes.title: Spelling Beast
episodes.summary: Bunsen proves bees are the best spellers when he turns into one and wins the spelling bee.

episodes.title: Mikey is a Beast
episodes.summary: An MMA fighter picks Bunsen to be his new mascot, so Mikey tries to prove that he is a beast too.

episodes.title: Fright at the Museum
episodes.summary: After discovering Bunsen's uncle in a museum, Bunsen and Mikey try to sneak him out before Amanda catches them.

episodes.title: Handsome Beast
episodes.summary: After Bunsen sprays himself with fancy body spray, he transforms into a hunk and becomes Amanda's desire.

episodes.title: Beast of Friends
episodes.summary: Bunsen is excited to take Mikey to Dimmsdale to meet Cosmo on their Friend-iversary, but trouble arises when Amanda secretly follows them, Part 1 of 2

episodes.title: Thunder and Frightening
episodes.summary: Amanda wants to use Bunsen's fear of thunder to scare him out of Muckledunk.

episodes.title: Eyes on the Pies
episodes.summary: Bunsen begins to lose his memory after getting hiccups.

episodes.title: Happy Beastsgiving
episodes.summary: It is the beast holiday, Beastgiving, so Mikey helps Bunsen deliver dream gifts to the citizens of Muckledunk.

episodes.title: Beastern Standard Time
episodes.summary: Bunsen's internal clock gets thrown off during daylight saving time.

episodes.title: Unhappy Campers
episodes.summary: Bunsen tries to help Mikey overcome his fear of the woods during an overnight camping trip.

episodes.title: Hall of Justice
episodes.summary: Amanda tries to sabotage Mikey and Bunsen after they get appointed as the new hall monitors.

episodes.title: Astro-Nots
episodes.summary: While on a field trip to MASA, Commander Cone gives Mikey and Bunsen a tour of MASA and accidentally launches them into space.

episodes.title: Cookie Monster
episodes.summary: Amanda turns into a ferocious beast and causes panic at school after eating Bunsen's beast cookie.

episodes.title: Braces for Disaster
episodes.summary: Mikey, Bunsen and Amanda team up to study minks after Amanda's tightened braces cause her to make mink calls.

episodes.title: Hug It Out-ch!
episodes.summary: Amanda gets trapped in Bunsen's hugging chair and can only be released once she is happy.

episodes.title: Guinea Some Lovin'
episodes.summary: Bunsen falls in love with a guinea pig and tries to woo her, while Amanda tries to sabotage the love affair.

episodes.title: Mikey-Plication
episodes.summary: To make time for their band, Bunsen clones Mikey so his clones can run all of his after school clubs.

episodes.title: The Case of the Cold Case
episodes.summary: Mikey and Bunsen go into detective mode after Commander Cone is framed for stealing Amanda's phone case.

episodes.title: Bunsen's Beast Ball
episodes.summary: Bunsen's beast ball tells him and Mikey to do fun things, until Amanda swaps out the ball for one of her own.

episodes.title: Bromeo and Juliet
episodes.summary: Mikey wants the lead role in a play so he can get a kiss from Sophie Sanders, but Amanda plans to sabotage his chances.
